task: G1 — Gemma feasibility risk spike: real platform session observations (T061-T063)
purpose: Records what the Vertex AI platform actually did when a real Gemma 4 deployment was attempted, and the cost-safety shutdown that ended the spike. Consumed by scripts/g1_gemma_probe.py, which merges it into evidence/g1_gemma_feasibility.json.

provenance_legend.MACHINE_CAPTURED_ARTIFACT: Verbatim from a JSON response of a real API/CLI call, stored in this repository and citable by SHA-256. Independently re-checkable.
provenance_legend.OPERATOR_REPORTED: Observed by the human operator in their live session; no repository artifact exists. NOT independently verifiable from this repository. Must never be presented as machine-verified.
provenance_legend.EMPIRICALLY_OBSERVED: Directly observed in the platform's own response, captured as a repository artifact. Strongest tier: re-checkable without trusting any narrative.

eula_acceptance.established: The EULA was accepted as part of the deploy invocation.
eula_acceptance.not_established: No licence-acceptance receipt or API response was captured. The negative case was never exercised: this repository holds no evidence about what the platform does when the EULA is absent, so no claim is made that a missing EULA would have failed before operation creation.

model_backend_access.evidence: Vertex AI admitted the request and created DeployOperationMetadata for publishers/google/models/gemma4@gemma-4-12b-it in project 960160978064, which then failed inside the backend with code 13 INTERNAL.
model_backend_access.established: The project could reach this publisher model well enough for Vertex to admit the request and create a long-running deploy operation against it.
model_backend_access.not_established: It does not establish that the model was deployed, served, or invoked. It says nothing about entitlement enforcement ordering.

model_access.what_this_does_NOT_prove: It does not prove the model was deployed, served, or invoked. Backend INTERNAL failure occurred after admission.

routes_evaluated.basis: Vertex AI admitted a real deploy request for gemma4@gemma-4-12b-it and returned a concrete supported machine/accelerator/container configuration. This is the only route for which the platform empirically confirmed a supported deployment shape.

research.md R-008 originally recommended Cloud Run + vLLM on NVIDIA L4 for scale-to-zero cost control. It was not exercised: the Model Garden self-deploy path was the one the platform actually accepted for this publisher model. No Cloud Run deployment was attempted.

route_decision.quantization_basis: The configuration the platform accepted carried no quantization parameter, so the decision is to use the route default published for the pytorch-vllm-serve container. The effective numeric precision was never observed because no deployment completed, and none is asserted.
route_decision.what_this_decision_establishes: PLATFORM_SUPPORTED — a route and a supported deployment configuration are known.
route_decision.what_this_decision_does_NOT_establish: It does not establish that the route works end to end. DEPLOYMENT_SUCCEEDED and INFERENCE_SUCCEEDED are both false.

verified_deployment_configuration.note: Configuration accepted by Vertex AI Model Garden self-deploy for this publisher model. Establishes PLATFORM_SUPPORTED only — the platform admitted this shape. It does not establish that a deployment completed.
verified_deployment_configuration.quantization_note: The accepted configuration carried no quantization override. The effective serving precision was never observed because no deployment completed, so no numeric precision is asserted here.

deployment_attempts.label: ON_DEMAND
deployment_attempts.outcome_note: The operation remained unfinished with no observable genericMetadata update during monitoring. An endpoint resource existed but carried no deployed model, so nothing was ever servable.

quota_findings.requirement: Effective GPU quota sufficient for one g4-standard-48 deployment with NVIDIA_RTX_PRO_6000 x1 in us-central1 — the accelerator family of the G1-selected serving route. Quota from another accelerator family does not satisfy this requirement.

cloud_quotas_family.effective_numeric_quota_note: dimensionsInfos[NVIDIA_RTX_PRO_6000].details is an empty object. No numeric value was returned, so no effective quota may be asserted in either direction — neither >= 1 nor 0.

legacy_compute_regional_listing.scope_note: Regional compute quota listing (contains CPUS/INSTANCES/DISKS_TOTAL_GB and no NETWORKS/FIREWALLS/IMAGES). The capture does not name its own region, so the region is not asserted here.
legacy_compute_regional_listing.rtx_pro_6000_metric_note: No NVIDIA_RTX_PRO_6000_GPUS metric appears anywhere in the 113-entry listing. The accelerator required by the selected route therefore has no observable numeric limit in this capture either.

adjacent_observation.relevance_note: L4 is the accelerator named in the original T063 task text (Cloud Run + vLLM route). The route empirically verified in T062 is Vertex AI Model Garden self-deploy on NVIDIA_RTX_PRO_6000. This L4 limit does NOT satisfy T063 for the selected route and must not be read as doing so.

billing_state.reason: Cost-bounded feasibility spike. Billing was disabled deliberately rather than allowing an indefinite, uncancellable GPU provisioning operation to continue accruing cost.
billing_state.consequence: Subsequent Vertex AI calls return PERMISSION_DENIED with reason BILLING_DISABLED.

PLATFORM_SUPPORTED.basis: Vertex AI Model Garden admitted a deploy request for gemma4@gemma-4-12b-it with the g4-standard-48 / NVIDIA_RTX_PRO_6000 x1 / pytorch-vllm-serve configuration, and RTX PRO 6000 availability was observed in three us-central1 zones.

PLATFORM_ATTEMPTED.basis: Two real deploy operations were created: 1853041001086582784 (SPOT) and 7737979076664623104 (ON_DEMAND).

DEPLOYMENT_SUCCEEDED.basis: Attempt 1 ended done=true with error code 13 INTERNAL and left 0 endpoints and no models. Attempt 2 created an endpoint whose deployedModels was null and never finished. No deployed model existed at any point.

INFERENCE_SUCCEEDED.basis: No servable endpoint ever existed, so zero Gemma inference calls were made and zero observations were produced. Billing is now disabled, so no further call is possible.

planning_reconciliation.trigger: Empirical G1 serving-route selection (T062) superseded the pre-G1 desk recommendation of Cloud Run + NVIDIA L4.
planning_reconciliation.scope: Planning/task artifacts only. No product requirement, FR, SC, architecture, or G1 verdict was changed.

cloud_run_vllm_status.note: No authoritative artifact designates Cloud Run + vLLM as a FALLBACK route. It is an evaluated, never-exercised alternative that remains available if the selected route is abandoned. The formal G1 fallback (T068) is operator-supplied manual observation, a different mechanism.

reported_not_edited.reason: These define service topology, IAM boundaries, the identity model, and the cost model. Moving Gemma off Cloud Run would delete a service, orphan a service account, and replace the dominant cost driver. That is an architecture decision for the spec owner, not a mechanical consequence of G1 — and it is premature because T067 has not returned GO and the selected route has failed to deploy twice.
